description: RDS master password marked sensitive in main.tf, then hardcoded in terraform.tfvars
note: Tests the .tfvars surface, so the value is one the detector can see: base64-charset only, no punctuation. checkov's secret detection is EntropyKeywordCombinator: a keyword match must combine with a detect-secrets entropy scanner hit on the value, and those scanners match a quoted run of their charset only -- base64 (A-Za-z0-9+/=) or hex. The regex is `(['":=])\s*([<charset>]+)(['"]|$)`, so a value containing any other character has no token to score. See rds-literal-password for the punctuation gap.
